verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly publishes a pricing page that shows a $0/mo forever tier, states there is no per-seat pricing because pricing is usage-based, defines a billable AI Run, and lists usage allowances such as 5K session replays and 5K errors per month. A community comment adds that client SDK usage is charged by MAU. However, the evidence pack never shows paid-tier price points or a first-party definition of the core flag usage meter (MAU or service connections), so the cost picture is only partly clear before committing. Missing for 10: paid-tier dollar amounts, first-party documentation of the MAU/connection metering for feature flags, overage rates.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can see published pricing and understand what drives cost (seats, MAUs, events, requests) before committing

citations.quote: No per-seat pricing. Invite your whole team; pricing is based on usage.
$0/ mo, forever... Unlimited seats... Unlimited feature flags
An AI Run is generated when you track an LLM request or run an online eval (LLM-as-a-judge).
